comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: 2026-10-21: fixed on main in 04f7d15f. Cause, from the run logs: hundreds of 2-3.8 s blocked spans mid-turn, Claude Code and Codex alike - PermissionRequest (mapped to blocked by both adapters) fires before the dialog is drawn, and for approvals nobody is asked. A blocked report the screen rules do not read now counts only once the screen has sat still for 1 s (or the rules read the prompt); the report before it keeps counting meanwhile. Fixed in detection, so pane wait, the maker watch, notifications and the sidebar all get it.

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From tooling feedback, 2026-10-17, 0.16.1-dev on the Mac, twice. Two Claude Code helpers sat idle in plan mode at an empty prompt. Their maker posted "slot N approved", then ran `muster pane wait --pane

--until blocked --timeout 120` to catch the plan-approval dialog. Both times the wait printed `

blocked` and exited 0 within a second, while `muster pane read` showed the agent mid-turn ("Drizzling… (3s)", plan mode, no dialog). For one of them @muster also told the maker it was blocked at a dialog. The real dialog appeared seconds later. A third helper, set up the same way, behaved correctly. Guess, unconfirmed: a blocked state left over from the plan-mode screen, or published before the woken turn's state landed. A wait for blocked should not answer from a state older than the post that woke the agent. Possibly one cause with a_2luQuuoeI (late 'blocked at a dialog' notices). Related: a_2dnADLXIN (a Return sent the moment a plan dialog reads blocked can be lost).
title: pane wait --until blocked answers at once while a woken agent is working
